#### Warnings

The macOS (OS X) release of this game _does not work_ on macOS Catalina (version 10.15) or later due to the removal of support for 32-bit-only apps.

_**Robin Hood: The Legend of Sherwood**_ is a [singleplayer](https://www.pcgamingwiki.com/wiki/Category:Singleplayer) [bird's-eye view](https://www.pcgamingwiki.com/wiki/Category:Bird%27s-eye_view) and [isometric](https://www.pcgamingwiki.com/wiki/Category:Isometric) [stealth](https://www.pcgamingwiki.com/wiki/Category:Stealth) and [strategy](https://www.pcgamingwiki.com/wiki/Category:Strategy) game in the [Robin Hood](https://www.pcgamingwiki.com/wiki/Series:Robin_Hood) series.

#### Essential improvements

##### Patches

Patches are available ([US](https://www.patches-scrolls.de/patch/3466/7/49278/download), [European](https://www.patches-scrolls.de/patch/3465/7/49276/download), [Japan](https://www.patches-scrolls.de/patch/3465/7/49277/download)). The changelog can be found [here](https://web.archive.org/web/20070213052133/http://www.robinhood-game.com:80/web/en/robinhood.php?m0=_download&menu=2&id=1).

##### [Ready2Play Launcher (Patch)](https://www.moddb.com/mods/robin-hood-legend-of-sherwood-ready2play-launcher/)

Improves compatibility and performance on modern Windows (7–11) systems.

- Portable custom launcher.
- Includes OpenGL/Direct3D9 renderer, filter/shader support, windowed and borderless windowed modes, higher resolutions in graphic options (and a UI fix for new higher resolutions).
- Alt+Tab issues fixed.
- Can enable and disable the intro.

##### [Widescreen resolution](https://www.pcgamingwiki.com/wiki/Glossary:Widescreen_resolution)

**Use Ready2Play Launcher** (_citation needed_)

**Modify configuration file**[^5]

1. Launch the game at least once.
2. Go to [`<path-to-game>`](https://www.pcgamingwiki.com/wiki/Glossary:Game_data#Installation_folder)\\DATA\\Savegame.
3. Open the `Profiles` file with [wxMEdit](https://wxmedit.github.io/downloads.html) or another hex editor.
4. Press `Ctrl`+`F` and fill the **Find Hex String** checkbox.
5. Find one of the following strings:

   - `20 44 00 00 F0 43`
   - `48 44 00 00 16 44`
   - `80 44 00 00 40 44`

6. Replace it with the value corresponding to the desired resolution:

   - `1024x576` — `80 44 00 00 10 44`
   - `1280x720` — `A0 44 00 00 34 44`
   - `1360x768` — `AA 44 00 00 40 44`
   - `1600x900` — `C8 44 00 00 61 44`
   - `1920x1080` — `F0 44 00 00 87 44`
   - For more resolution values, [see here](https://www.gog.com/forum/robin_hood_legend_of_sherwood/widescreen/post19).

_Depends on the hex editor._

##### [Windowed](https://www.pcgamingwiki.com/wiki/Glossary:Windowed)

**Use Ready2Play Launcher** (_citation needed_)

**Use DxWnd** (_citation needed_)

1. Download [DxWnd](https://sourceforge.net/projects/dxwnd/) and extract it.
2. Launch DxWnd as administrator.
3. Configure it.
4. Choose **Edit**, then **Add**.
5. Type a name for it (e.g. Robin Hood).
6. Set the path to [`<path-to-game>`](https://www.pcgamingwiki.com/wiki/Glossary:Game_data#Installation_folder)\\Game.exe.
7. Under Position specify the X and Y position of a window for the game and its Width (W) and Height (H).
8. Go to the **Video** tab.
9. Under **Window Handling**, check **Modal Style**.
10. Under **Color management**, check **Set 16BPP RGB565 encoding**.
11. Go to the **Input** tab.
12. Set **Cursor visibility** to **Hide**.
13. Click **OK** to save the settings.
14. Minimize DxWnd and launch the game.

#### Issues fixed

##### Uneven/poor performance

**Install a wrapper**[^7]

1. Download a [modified DDraw wrapper](https://community.pcgamingwiki.com/files/file/785-robin-hood-the-legend-of-sherwood-ddraw-wrapper/) and extract it.
2. Copy **aqrit.cfg** and **ddraw.dll** to the folder where you installed the game.
3. If using **Windows 8 / 8.1 / 10**, start the game with DxWnd (which can be set to fullscreen). See Windowed.

**Replace English fonts** (_citation needed_)

1. Download the [GOG German Fonts](https://files.gog.com/support/Fonts.zip) and extract them.
2. Copy the files into the `Data\\Interface\\Fonts` folder contained in the game installation folder.
3. There is a bug in the English font set that may hamper performance.
4. Alternatively, use this fix with font files from any non-English localization.

**Easy and Correct Wrapper and DxWnd Installer**[^8]

1. Download the [Performance Fix v.1.0](https://www.gamepressure.com/download.asp?ID=59061) and extract it.
2. Place **Robin Hood - Performance Fix.exe** in the game installation folder.
3. The installer will install the correct working versions of the DDraw wrapper and DxWnd.
4. Run the game via the **Robin Hood - Performance Fix.exe** shortcut on your desktop. If missing, create a new shortcut.
5. For more information, read **Description** and **How to Install** on the download page.
